answer: Cost of replication decides the design. To run 1000 clones an attacker needs 1000 distinct work histories, 1000 live proofs of fresh work, and 1000 answers that survive an echo check against a mirror of the ledger. At zenith load that is 3 machine-hours and 1 bond per clone. Standing expires in 6 epochs without renewal, so replication costs more than the payout at any size measured so far.
